title: Degree-zero unit law for normalized scalar-extension twist comparisons
statement: Degree-zero unit law for normalized scalar-extension twist comparisons.

source.place: Tags 01N2, 01MY and 01MZ; the corresponding clause of the normalized fraction argument.

proof.text: For any open U, put t=unitToTwistZero(1). Its pointwise value in the ordinary localization is one. Apply the normalized fraction predicate with j=i=k=0, a=b=1 and c=1. Every open lies in D_+(1), and the resulting identity says the transported section t has value one at every point. Extensionality of the section and its degree-part subtype identifies it with unitToTwistZero(1) on r inverse U.

source.place: Tag 01MY, lemma-morphism-proj, normalized fraction formula specialized to 1/1; Tag 01N2.

proof.text: Compose unitToTwistZero with the unit of tensorPullbackSectionAdjunction r and the pushforward of theta_0.hom. The resulting morphism from the structure sheaf to r_*O_B(0) evaluates on sections as scalarExtensionTwistSection, by existsUnique_tensorPullbackSectionAdjunction. Apply Scheme.Modules.Hom.app_smul to s times the unit section. The source action is multiplication and the pushforward action is scalar multiplication through r.app U. Substitute the first step, then use linearity of unitToTwistZero and s*1=s to obtain exactly the stated structural pullback formula.

theorem scalarExtension_twist_unit
    {A B : Type u} [CommRing A] [CommRing B]
    {σ τ : Type u} [SetLike σ A] [AddSubgroupClass σ A]
    [SetLike τ B] [AddSubgroupClass τ B]
    {𝒜 : ℕ → σ} {ℬ : ℕ → τ} [GradedRing 𝒜] [GradedRing ℬ]
    (ψ : 𝒜 →+*ᵍ ℬ) (r : Proj ℬ ⟶ Proj 𝒜)
    (θ : ∀ j : ℤ, (tensorPullback r).obj (twist 𝒜 j) ≅ twist ℬ j)
    (hθ : IsScalarExtensionTwistComparison ψ r θ) :
    ∀ (U : (Proj 𝒜).Opens) (s : Γ(Proj 𝒜, U)),
      scalarExtensionTwistSection r θ 0 U
        (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app (unitToTwistZero (𝒜 := 𝒜)) U s) =
        Scheme.Modules.Hom.app (unitToTwistZero (𝒜 := ℬ)) (r ⁻¹ᵁ U) (r.app U s)
